avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Increased serotonergic activity; risk of serotonin syndrome
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue St. John's Wort or do not initiate duloxetine; allow 2-week washout if switching

avoid_supplements.name: SAMe (S-adenosyl methionine)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive serotonergic effects; increased serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on serotonin syndrome symptoms

avoid_supplements.name: 5-HTP
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Direct serotonin precursor; potentiates serotonergic activity
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated with duloxetine; recommend alternative approaches

avoid_supplements.name: Tramadol
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Combined serotonergic activity and opioid effects; significant serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative analgesics

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild stimulant properties; theoretical additive noradrenergic effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased tremor, anxiety, or agitation; use with caution

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate serotonergic effects; bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for bleeding signs and serotonin syndrome symptoms

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet effects; additive with duloxetine's antiplatelet properties
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for unusual bleeding or bruising; generally safe at standard doses

avoid_foods.name: Excessive caffeine-containing beverages/foods
avoid_foods.mechanism: Additive stimulant and noradrenergic effects; increased anxiety, tremor, and insomnia
avoid_foods.action: Limit caffeine intake to <200mg daily; counsel on caffeine content in coffee, tea, energy drinks, and chocolate

caution_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented products)
caution_foods.mechanism: Duloxetine has weak MAOI-like properties; minimal clinical risk but theoretical hypertensive potential
caution_foods.action: Monitor blood pressure; excessive tyramine intake unlikely to cause issues but avoid large quantities

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: CNS depression; impaired judgment and motor control
caution_foods.action: Counsel to limit or avoid alcohol; assess for additive CNS effects

monitoring_notes: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, muscle rigidity, hyperthermia) especially during initiation or with supplement additions. Assess baseline and periodic blood pressure, as duloxetine can increase BP, particularly with stimulant co-exposures.
